subject: Okanagan Valley Tree Fruit Authority
summary: The 2002 Estimates announce this future wind-up date. This does not confirm that wind-up occurred.
limitation: Find the final annual report or repeal/completion instrument.

subject: Agricultural Land Development Program
summary: The 2002 Estimates report termination on this date while describing repayments of older loans.

subject: Provincial Home Acquisition Wind Up Special Account
summary: The account was established to wind up legacy housing loans and assistance; the underlying Acts were reportedly repealed 31 March 2004. The account is not the original program.
limitation: Retrospective budget statement; legislation not independently checked in this event.

subject: Production Insurance Special Account
summary: February Estimates describe replacing the Crop Insurance Fund on 1 April 2005. This is future relative to publication.

subject: Medical Review Panel process
summary: Medical Review Panel provisions were repealed, but proceedings already before the panels were to be completed.
exceptions: Pending proceedings continue; not all work necessarily ended on repeal.

subject: Workers’ Compensation Appeal Tribunal
summary: WCAT replaced the Workers’ Compensation Review Board and the Appeal Division of the Workers’ Compensation Board.
predecessors: Appeal Division of the Workers’ Compensation Board

subject: British Columbia Farm Industry Review Board
summary: Specified provisions took effect and regulatory Farm Practices Board / BC Marketing Board wording changed to BC Farm Industry Review Board.
limitation: This verifies the regulatory transition, not every element of a fully reconstructed legal amalgamation.

subject: BC Financial Services Authority
summary: BCFSA commenced operations and assumed FICOM regulatory accountabilities. This is operational commencement, not necessarily the legal incorporation date.

subject: Financial Institutions Commission
summary: The official history associates FICOM dissolution with full implementation of BCFSA in November 2019.
limitation: Do not borrow the separate operational-start day as an independently verified dissolution day.

subject: BCFSA and real estate regulators
summary: BCFSA integrated RECBC and Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate regulatory accountabilities.
predecessors: Real Estate Council of British Columbia
Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate
limitation: The continuing statutory Superintendent role is not labelled abolished.

subject: Real Estate Council of British Columbia
locator: Dissolution of the Real Estate Council of British Columbia
summary: RECBC was dissolved on integration; existing proceedings continued through the Superintendent or BCFSA according to the matter.
exceptions: Retain continuing proceedings and distinct statutory roles.

subject: BC Energy Regulator
summary: BC Oil and Gas Commission became BC Energy Regulator effective 17 February; the notice was issued on 22 February. Expanded-mandate provisions were staged.

subject: SkilledTradesBC
summary: Industry Training Authority became SkilledTradesBC. This body is distinct from the similarly named appeal board.

subject: Skilled Trades BC Appeal Board
summary: Industry Training Appeal Board was renamed when the Skilled Trades BC Act came into force.

subject: Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
summary: Oil and Gas Appeal Tribunal was renamed Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal, on a different date from the regulator rename.

subject: BC Timber Sales
summary: BCTS replaced the Small Business Forest Enterprise Program within the Ministry of Forests.
limitation: The older special-account creation date is not the BCTS program founding date.

subject: Tourism British Columbia
summary: Repeal dissolved Tourism BC and vested assets and obligations in government. The commencement table fixes 1 April 2010.
limitation: Destination BC is a later corporation, not automatically one uninterrupted identity.

subject: Destination BC Corp.
summary: Destination BC was established under the Business Corporations Act; operational commencement is separate.

subject: Destination BC Corp.
summary: Destination BC began operations after its November 2012 establishment.

subject: Royal British Columbia Museum Corporation
summary: The corporation was formed under the Museum Act on 1 April 2003.
limitation: Do not replace the older museum or Archives histories with a 2003 founding date.

subject: Community Living British Columbia
summary: CLBC was established and assumed adult community living service responsibility. Staff support for children’s services under agreement was distinct from retained MCFD funding, policy, monitoring and accountability.
from_ministry: Ministry of Children and Family Development
limitation: Not a transfer of every children’s-service responsibility.

subject: Provincial Capital Commission
locator: Clause (a), together with Dissolution Act s. 2
summary: OIC 128/2014 brought the Act into force on 25 March 2014. The Act dissolved the commission and vested its property and obligations in government.
limitation: 24 March assent is not the commencement date.

subject: BC Human Rights Commission
summary: The report dates elimination of the Commission and Advisory Council to proclamation on 31 March 2003; the existing Tribunal continued under direct access.
limitation: No automatic continuity with a later commissioner’s office.

subject: Human Rights Advisory Council
summary: The report dates elimination of the Commission and Advisory Council to proclamation on 31 March 2003; the existing Tribunal continued under direct access.
limitation: No automatic continuity with a later commissioner’s office.

subject: BC Human Rights Tribunal
summary: The pre-existing Tribunal moved to direct complaint access and received transferred files.
limitation: A process change, not the Tribunal’s original establishment.

subject: Child care responsibilities / Child Care Division
summary: The annual report confirms completion of the child-care responsibility transfer from MCFD to Education and Child Care as of 1 April 2022.
from_ministry: Ministry of Children and Family Development
to_ministry: Ministry of Education and Child Care
limitation: Do not infer creation dates or exact movement dates for every nested registry/program.
